headline: Southern New Hampshire drop first conference points at Assumption
dek: Three days after scoring seven at Pace, Southern New Hampshire were held to a draw at Assumption, the first conference points they have dropped. Ten matches in they are still unbeaten, and their four-point lead over the three programmes on six is intact.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's thirty-seven goals come from at least fifteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is not one player's work; the three programmes level at the foot of the chart on eleven have very different records, Bentley with four wins to Saint Michael's one.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire are the last programme yet to lose after Saint Anselm ended Pace's unbeaten start.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire have won seven matches and drawn three, and are the only programme without a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored ten of Assumption's twenty goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost six matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Franklin Pierce's win at Queens is their fifth of the season against two draws; both of their two defeats have come against non-conference opponents.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm's defeat at Mercy is their fifth of the season against four wins, and they remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

last_match.line: Franklin Pierce have still lost only to non-conference opponents; Queens had already won at Assumption this season.

next_match.line: Southern New Hampshire have yet to lose; Bentley arrive from a home defeat by American International, their first in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
